text_block_list.text:
Before starting our training as usual,
I shared some knowledge I'd learned from books with Sakura Laurel.
choice_data_list: There's body care that keeps leg fatigue from lingering.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes, please tell me! So that we can make our training as fulfilling as possible, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
Time to change horseshoes again!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I started running with you, Trainer,
my horseshoes have been wearing down so much faster.
choice_data_list: Huh!? Am I pushing you too hard...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, my mother told me:
A worn-down horseshoe is...

text_block_list.name: Young Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Mama!
I got my horseshoe changed, see?

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you did splendidly, Laurel—my lovely little Lola.

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Mother
text_block_list.text: Then let's make sure to keep the old one safe.

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Because it's proof of how hard you worked, Laura! You practiced so much it wore down like this."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's why I keep worn-out horseshoes
as precious treasures.
Because, after all, these are—
choice_data_list: It's proof of Laurel's hard work.
It's proof of Laurel's hard work.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Bzzzzt! Too bad, that's incorrect!
This is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: This is proof of all the hard work Trainer-san and I put in!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I told you, didn't I?
'Ever since I started running with you, Trainer,
my horseshoes have been wearing down faster.'"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: The reason I'm able to run so much is because Trainer gives me such careful and attentive guidance.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! From here on—
let us walk as many steps together as there are horseshoes!
